readerCopy.body: A clear boundary or written agreement can stop a sensitive need from being reopened every time somebody forgets, pushes, or asks again. When Saturn sextiles Chiron, structure and sensitivity cooperate, allowing a schedule, payment plan, division of responsibility, or documented condition to remove repeated negotiation from the same issue. The structure is not evidence that the need was finally serious enough to deserve accommodation. Its value is that the need no longer has to be argued from scratch every week.
